test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How many countries are part of SAARC?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) **was founded on **December 8, 1985**.
 
• Its Secretariat was established in **Kathmandu, Nepal,** on January 17, 1987.
 
• SAARC comprises eight member countries:** Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka.**
 
• The objectives of SAARC include enhancing the welfare of the people of South Asia, improving their standard of living, fostering economic growth, social advancement, and cultural enrichment in the region.
 
• SAARC also aims to ensure every individual has the opportunity to lead a dignified life and realize their full potential.
 
• Additionally, SAARC endeavours to strengthen collaboration with other developing nations and to engage with international and regional organizations sharing similar goals and objectives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• SAARC **Heads of State convene** at annual Summits, with the most recent one held in Kathmandu in 2014.
 
• Subsequently, Nepal has been hosting informal meetings of SAARC Foreign Ministers annually. The latest such gathering took place virtually in September 2020 alongside the UNGA.
 
• To address the challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic, SAARC devised and enacted a regional emergency fund totaling approximately 22 million USD.
 
• This fund aims to enhance cooperation among member states in combatting the pandemic's effects and supporting collective efforts towards recovery and resilience.
